spec: Fees are the amount times the currency's rate, rounded half up to a whole minor unit. A discount never makes a total negative. An empty amount counts as zero.

candidates.claim: roundFee truncates instead of rounding half up, so a fee of 2.5 becomes 2.
applyDiscount can return a negative total when the discount is larger than the total.
parseAmount throws on an empty string instead of returning zero.
feeFor silently charges the GBP rate for an unknown currency.
